answer.says: Ramesh, I am aware of the account. I have no cash to spare today, as you know, but I will make a note to the Directorate. Sit. Do not stand there blocking the light.
answer.thought: The pot is empty because the hand that fills it is stopped by a lack of coin, yet the stove burns. I am the cause of this mechanical failure, yet I must not humiliate the servant by begging for the tea he has already made. I will sit and let the silence do the work of negotiation.
